typeDescriptions.BUSINESS_CARD_WEBSITE: Small calling-card site: who you are, what you do, and how to reach you.
typeDescriptions.COMPANY_WEBSITE: Company site: about, services, cases, and contacts. Not a shop.
typeDescriptions.MOBILE_APP: Legacy mobile app. New deals pick a real type plus App.
typeDescriptions.WEB_APP: Custom system outside ready-made kinds: your process and screens.
typeDescriptions.CRM: Client and deal database: pipeline and seller tasks.
typeDescriptions.ECOMMERCE: Online shop of your own catalog: cart, order, and payment. One seller.
typeDescriptions.SAAS: Legacy SaaS kind. Hidden from new picks.
typeDescriptions.LANDING: One page for a lead or call. Not a company website.
typeDescriptions.ERP: Company resources: purchasing, production, finance, and warehouses.
typeDescriptions.PRODUCT_CATALOG: Product showcase with cards and filters, without a cart or checkout.
typeDescriptions.BLOG: Article site: sections, authors, and a feed. Not a page on a company site.
typeDescriptions.NEWS_MEDIA_PORTAL: News portal with sections and an editorial desk. Heavier than a blog.
typeDescriptions.EVENT_WEBSITE: Site for one event: program, speakers, venue. No tickets.
typeDescriptions.MARKETPLACE: Many sellers, shared orders. Not one company's shop.
typeDescriptions.B2B_COMMERCE_PORTAL: Wholesale dealer cabinet: own prices and company orders.
typeDescriptions.BOOKING_SYSTEM: Book a service, table, or specialist. Not ticket sales.
typeDescriptions.TICKETING_SYSTEM: Sell and check tickets for an event or a screening.
typeDescriptions.POS: In-store till: receipt, shift, scanner. Not an online shop. App and Desktop.
typeDescriptions.HRM: People ops: employees, leave, documents, and org structure.
typeDescriptions.LMS: Learning: courses, lessons, students, progress, and tests.
typeDescriptions.TASK_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM: Team tasks: assign, status, deadlines. Not a CRM.
typeDescriptions.HELP_DESK_SYSTEM: Incoming tickets: queues and client correspondence.
typeDescriptions.REGISTRATION_SYSTEM: Application and admission: accepted or not. Not ticket sales.
typeDescriptions.EVENT_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM: Event operations: guests, program, check-in, and badges.
typeDescriptions.DOCUMENT_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM: Company documents: versions, approval, routes, and archive.
typeDescriptions.INVENTORY_SYSTEM: Stock in, out, and counts. Not an online shop.
typeDescriptions.KNOWLEDGE_BASE: Articles and search for client or staff help.
typeDescriptions.INDUSTRY_OPERATIONS_SYSTEM: System for one industry: clinic, workshop, plant. Not a general BOS.
typeDescriptions.BOS: The company's whole operations in one product: clients, tasks, records.
typeDescriptions.CUSTOMER_PORTAL: Customer cabinet: orders, documents, tickets, and profile.
typeDescriptions.PARTNER_PORTAL: Dealer or agent cabinet: terms, requests, and materials.
typeDescriptions.BRANDING: Brand identity: colors, type, and style.
typeDescriptions.DESIGN: Design work without a coded product.
typeDescriptions.OTHER: Catch-all when no listed type fits.
